outcome: Need for intensive care unit (ICU) admission
cohort: Pregnant women with breech presentation, grouped into spontaneous vaginal delivery (n=72), induced or augmented vaginal delivery (n=32), and cesarean delivery (n=253)
finding: While cesarean delivery for breech presentation had the lowest overall fetal complication rate, the study highlights the need to consider risks and benefits of each delivery mode in breech presentation as induced vaginal deliveries had the highest rate of both fetal and maternal complications.
mod_finding: This study is the first in literature to have investigated and analyzed neonatal complications in breech delivery according to different delivery modes including induced vaginal delivery.
